AND A.COM_CODE IN (SELECT DISTINCT M.BUYER FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG M, ICOMCOD2 C WHERE C.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND C.TYPE = 'C001' AND C.CODE = M.KEP_DEPT AND M.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND M.STATUS = 'C' AND M.KEP_DEPT = #{st_dept} AND M.KEP_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} )
AND A.COM_CODE IN (SELECT BUYER FROM BUYEROWN WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id})
AND A.COM_CODE IN
#{item}
AND NVL(B.COMORG_NAME, A.COM_NAME_LOC) LIKE '%'||#{st_comorg_name}||'%'
AND A.COM_NAME_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_com_name_loc}||'%'
